highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia milestone m151 and improves performance across frequently used APIs.
highlights_body: Text shaping, tag parsing, color conversion, and premultiplication now avoid several allocations and native calls. WebAssembly also gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine moves to Skia m151 and includes four subsequent rounds of upstream Chrome m151 fixes.
Legacy shader-context support has been restored to correct CPU raster output affected by the engine upgrade.
New ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads avoid string allocation at call sites while speeding up hexadecimal color parsing.

bullets.lead: GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe code
bullets.detail: Removing its unnecessary unsafe modifier lets consumers use GRContextOptions without enabling unsafe compilation.

bullets.lead: Cropped image decode no longer leaks
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases its native resource when the crop rectangle falls outside the image bounds.
The Skia submodule no longer redefines SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM in toolchains that already provide it.

bullets.lead: Hot paths allocate less and avoid native calls
bullets.detail: Color conversion, premultiplication, tag parsing, UTF-8 text ingestion, and shaped-glyph access now use managed math, pooled encoding, or zero-copy spans.
Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries support the new exnref exception model used by .NET 11 WebAssembly.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly compatibility work, Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11, and visual regression testing

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Updates the Skia engine to milestone 151, alongside documentation and release-tooling improvements.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 updates the Skia engine to milestone 151.

bullets.text: Updates the bundled Skia engine to milestone 151.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: A maintenance preview focused on allocation-free text and color parsing.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 focuses on allocation-free text handling and faster `SKColor` parsing.

bullets.text: Adds faster `SKColor` parsing and allocation-free text and tag handling.
Corrects release-note classification for Skia engine syncs.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Finalizes performance, WebAssembly, raster, and resource-lifetime improvements before the stable release.
v4.151.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support, removes native calls from color hot paths, and fixes raster output and an image-decoding resource leak.

bullets.text: Moves color conversion and premultiplication hot paths to managed code.
Restores CPU raster behavior and fixes a native resource leak during cropped image decoding.
Includes the latest upstream Chrome m151 engine fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Text ingestion and tag parsing now avoid per-call allocations, while shaped-glyph results use zero-copy spans.
